data_fields.name: non_attacker_offset
data_fields.donor_constant: +2 if target can attack something else, +3 if it can move, +4 otherwise

data_fields.name: inactive_target_offset
data_fields.donor_constant: +1 for an incomplete or loaded target

data_fields.name: acquire_range
data_fields.donor_constant: unit type value (game data, not in donor); distance = range x 32

data_fields.name: min_weapon_range
data_fields.donor_constant: weapon minimum range (game data, not read)

best_idea: Pick the enemy that can hit this fighter right now first, then the nearest; keep the current target while it stays in range, and switch only to a strictly better bucket.
decision_why: Take the threat-first buckets, nearest-in-bucket pick and sticky reacquire rule; change the bucket inputs to Frankendom's fight state (in range and active, not StarCraft unit classes); keep MAX_ATTACKERS = 3 as a separate engine rule; reject a client-side RNG tie-break.
acceptance: In a three-on-one server test, a fighter keeps an in-range enemy that can hit it as its target while it stays in range, and an enemy that cannot hit it right now is not chosen while a hitter is in range.
